verdict.rationale: vLLM is an API-first, headless inference engine with no UI documented in the evidence. Its primary interfaces are an OpenAI-compatible API server plus Anthropic Messages API and gRPC [vllm-docs-9, vllm-docs-15, vllm-docs-27]. Features such as tool_choice, structured outputs and reasoning fields are documented as exposed through the API [vllm-docs-19, vllm-docs-20, vllm-docs-21], so programmatic access is the default rather than a secondary path. Missing for 10: no explicit statement that runtime API coverage includes server-level configuration (some options appear to be launch-time CLI flags only, e.g. --trust-remote-code), no independent hands-on corroboration of full API coverage, and no llms.txt (HTTP 404) for AI-native discovery.
